title: pi-clarify npm extension rewrites prompts before Pi coding agent
summary: dodo-reach publishes pi-clarify on npm (`pi install npm:pi-clarify`), an extension that rewrites underspecified user prompts before Pi sees them to cut clarification round-trips.
question_it_answers: How do I reduce clarification turns when prompting the Pi coding agent?

claims.text: pi-clarify intercepts and rewrites the user message before forwarding it to Pi.
claims.evidence: it rewrites your prompt before sending, so you spend fewer turns explaining what you meant
claims.subject: agent-harness-loops
